title: ParallelsDesktop.txt - Parallels Desktop for Mac (Build 1940) creates /Library/Parallels/.dhcpd_configuration with insecure permissions (666)
note: Packet Storm advisory page: 'Posted Oct 30, 2006 / Authored by naif', body signed '-naif' ('While testing the useful parallels for osx...'). Same advisory as the known Full-Disclosure post (seclists 2006/Oct/581) and Secunia SA22634 / CVE-2006-5817, but a distinct publication. Verified on Web Archive capture https://web.archive.org/web/20240508164212/http://packetstormsecurity.com/files/51479/ParallelsDesktop.txt.html (live page is behind a bot challenge, not bypassed).
